items.title: The Picard group of projective space over a unique factorisation domain is the integers, generated by the twisting sheaf
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file divisors.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the Picard group of projective space over a unique factorisation domain as the integers via the twisting sheaves, with the case of a field as a special case (statement lines 7254-7264). The counted proof is a complete cocycle computation: it uses the triviality of the Picard groups of the standard charts, identifies the units on the overlaps with powers of ratios of the coordinates times base units, simplifies the cocycle using the condition on triple intersections to a single exponent, and matches the result with the cocycles of the twisting sheaves (proof lines 7266-7301). It is H2: the computation is carried out in the counted span, with the cited input being the triviality of Picard groups over unique factorisation domains.
